question_summary: Foreman discovered a conflicting utility line beneath the slab in Area C, differing from the assumed condition in the Project Manual, and proposes shifting the layout locally while holding all other work per plan.
proposed_solution: Shift the layout locally at the conflict point and hold everything else per plan.
deadline_text: Please respond this week so we can keep the crew moving.
